pr_title: Truncating watcher history if it is too large
pr_body:
This adds a new `xpack.watcher.max.history.record.size` setting (defaulting to 10 MB), and truncates any watcher history items that exceed that size before indexing them.
Closes #94745
pr_comments: Hi @masseyke, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: Watcher ought to limit the size of individual .watcher_history documents
issue_context.body:
### Description

Watcher results can sometimes be enormous. We have seen at least one case of a watcher history document being sent through BulkProcessor being over 1.5 GB. This can cause cluster instability, and a 1.5 GB watch result is not ever going to be very useful. We ought to limit the size of the `WatchExecutionResult` that we put in the `WatchRecord` that is going to `.watcher_history`.
comments: After a team discussion we decided to move forward with this. We'll truncate the result (as described in the description) rather than dropping the document altogether.

Just a data point -- I just pulled down a 79 MB watcher history record from a cluster. The vast majority of that was in the `result` field -- the result.input.payload and the result.actions fields are especially large.

review_comments: I'm also assuming that adding a new field to the history store doesn't need any further changes to mappings or anything?

It looks like `input` doesn't specify dynamic, so it defaults to dynamic (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/template-resources/src/main/resources/watch-history.json#L108). And `result` is explicitly dynamic (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/template-resources/src/main/resources/watch-history.json#L136).
